answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 43350 Country: India Title: Tawaf Question: Is it allowed to kiss the Hajr-e-Aswad if we get a chance except during tawaf? If not, when a person kiss the Hajr-e-Aswad if he gets chance while he is not in the state of ihram and also not doing any tawaf? What will be the jaza for him? Answer ID: 43350 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 331/322/N=1434) It is sunnah as per all the Fuqaha for those who are performing tawaf to do istilam of Hajr-e-Aswad and kissing it provided one is capable to kiss it and by this act other people are not harmed. But it is not proved from the holy Quran, Hadith, Sahaba, Tabiyeen and Tabe Tabiyeen etc to kiss Hajr-e-Aswad and go in Mataf only for the same act. Also those who enter in mataf only to kiss the Hajr-e-Aswad, they are causing trouble to those who are doing tawaf, hence it should be avoided it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
